note: San Bernardino NF campground in fir, pine and oak at the foot of Snow Summit, on the edge of Big Bear Lake village, run by a concessionaire. Tight turnaround; the agency says it suits tents best. The nearest dump station is at Serrano Campground across the lake. --Claude
